notes.title: Update 0.1.04
notes.notes:
In this update we updated some of the graphical images and completed the Brazilian rating system review.  We want to thank everyone for playing our game.  Keep sending us feedback on bug fixes, improvements or anything you would like to see in the game. 

Thank you 
ZUGALU

notes.title: Update 0.1.03
notes.notes:
Update 0.1.03 is now live.  

- Added the keyboard overlays to the egg progression in mode 4.

- Updated some of the art assets.

- Bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.1.02
notes.notes: Thank you for enjoying the game. We have had requests for adding keyboard support. So in this update we have done that. All modes can now be played with a keyboard. However we are still working on the overlays for game mode 4 egg progression. Also in this update are bug fixes and rating updates. Thanks again for playing and sending us feedback while we work through early access.
